We need to fetch list of all airports via list_all_airports. Then pick first two entries (assuming order). Then call get_flight_cost with travel_from=first_code, travel_to=second_code, travel_date="2024-11-15", travel_class="economy". Provide result.

Thus we need to invoke list_all_airports then get_flight_cost. We'll do it stepwise.
